LanguageData.OmniForceFieldDome.label: Force Field Dome Generator
LanguageData.OmniForceFieldDome.description: A Force Field Dome Generator is a device derived from Outerrealm technology, capable of generating a high-dimensional field domain to form a dome for protection and defense. It can resist threats and harsh environments, and is used to quickly establish a safe area in adverse conditions.\n\nTip: The dome is designed for outdoor use. Do not let the dome cover areas that already have rooms. Room areas can use shields.
